description.short: Envision a customer's human-led, agent-operated Frontier company.
description.full: Frontier Envisioning supports evidence-led workshops, customer context discovery, an interactive Company Blueprint, agent identity kits, business value cases in CHF, PRD and solution design, and optional process ontology design. Version 1.11.0 ships seven GA product wrappers and optional Preview Envisioning Agent Factory, which prepares a reviewed starter-repository ZIP from a pinned template and envisioning artefacts. FinOps is not included. Outputs distinguish assumptions, evidence, gaps and human decisions; no installation grants financial, repository, source-transfer or tenant permission. The repository and current development distribution remain private and Microsoft internal; technical export checks do not grant external publication clearance.
